answers.how: The cat moves approximately 120 px in 2.042 s, giving a scale of 0.0177 m/px. Its length including the tail is about 48.5 px.
The beach chair is approximately 91 px wide. Using the cat-derived scale of 0.0177 m/px gives 1.61 m.
The paving stones are approximately 64.5 px wide. Multiplying by the cat-derived scale of 0.0177 m/px gives 1.14 m.
The swimming ring's horizontal extent is approximately 64 px. Using 0.0177 m/px gives 1.13 m.
Frames surrounding 0.5 s show the ring moving approximately 94 px/s. Multiplying by the cat-derived scale of 0.0177 m/px gives approximately 1.67 m/s.
